annotation.title_clean: Правовые аспекты гражданско-правовой ответственности за причинение вреда действиями робота как квазисубъекта гражданско-правовых отношений
annotation.title_en: Legal Aspects of Civil Liability for Damages in Tort as a Result of Quasi Party Robot Performance
annotation.summary_en: Russian journal article on civil tort liability for harm caused by autonomous AI robots. It proposes distinguishing AI-equipped "Robots" from mechanisms, introducing the Robot as a quasi-subject of civil law, and a classifier of tort categories, damage levels and responsible persons (inventor, programmer, manufacturer, owner/user, third party).
key_provisions_or_claims: Divide robots into autonomous AI robots and non-AI machine-mechanisms; define 'Robot' as the former.
Introduce the Robot as a quasi-subject of civil legal relations in the Civil Code.
Autonomous Robots are neither sources of heightened danger nor defective goods under current Russian law.
Candidate liable persons: inventor, programmer, manufacturer, owner/user, third party.
Propose a tort classifier with liability categories A-C, damage levels 1-3, person categories I-IV and industry codes.
